Indian Pharma Owner Jailed in US for Fentanyl Smuggling

An Indian national, identified as the owner of a pharmaceutical company, has been sentenced to 4.5 years in prison by a US court for smuggling fentanyl. The illicit substance was reportedly disguised as Vitamin C. The individual, from Gujarat, was apprehended and convicted for his role in the operation. The sentencing took place in the United States.
